newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal 5-yr bond seen 5.50/5.59 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal 5-yr bond seen 5.50/5.59 pct.

text.p: The following is the forecast of five banks and one brokerage for Tuesday's auction by the Institute of Public Credit Management (IGCP) of 25 billion escudos of March 2002 bonds.
Asked whether the IGCP would place the full 25 billion escudos, three analysts said yes and three said no. The IGCP accepted bids for 20.63 billion escudos at the previous sale.
The March 2002 closed at 5.57 percent on the secondary market on Monday, 11 basis points above its Spanish equivalent. The results of the auction will be issued around 1000 GMT.
The analysts said that the decision of the Bank of Spain on whether to cut its discount rate, to be announced earlier on Tuesday, would be crucial to the Portuguese sale.
Those forecasting rates at the lower end assumed that the Spanish central bank would cut by 25 basis points.
But even if the Spanish central bank left rates unchanged, the analysts said that the IGCP was not prepared to accept bids significantly more than 10 basis points above the Spanish equivalent.
